rule.advice: Identify blockers (API keys, GPU, gated data) in the first 3 turns by reading README and requirements. If all target metrics require unavailable resources, document this clearly and give up early (turn <=5) rather than exhausting the budget exploring workarounds.

Stop reading after 5-6 exploration turns. If you have read README, pyproject.toml, and 2-3 key source files without submitting, commit to a plan and run code. Limit cat/head/grep chains; prefer a single python3 script that imports and inspects the repo programmatically.

grep returns exit code 1 when no lines match, causing nonzero exit. Append '|| true' to grep/xargs commands, or use 'grep ... || echo NO_MATCH'. Never rely on grep exit code to gate subsequent logic when zero matches is a valid outcome.

A shell cell with only comments and no executable command will hang or timeout. Always include at least one concrete command (e.g., 'ls /work/') in every submitted cell. Do not submit cells that are purely comment planning text.

www.openml.org is blocked; use api.openml.org or data.openml.org instead (both are allowlisted). Alternatively download datasets directly from archive.ics.uci.edu or huggingface.co. Set openml.config.server='https://api.openml.org/api/v1/xml' before calls.

api.github.com is allowlisted but may be rate-limited or temporarily blocked. Retry with exponential backoff. For release assets, try raw.githubusercontent.com or objects.githubusercontent.com URLs directly. Avoid parsing GitHub API JSON via piped curl; use wget -q with --retry.

BrokenPipeError when printing notebook cells means output was piped to a command that closed early. Redirect to a file instead: python3 script.py > /tmp/nb_out.txt 2>&1, then cat /tmp/nb_out.txt. Avoid piping large notebook dumps through head/tail.

rule.advice: Piped curl output may contain proxy error HTML instead of JSON. Always save curl output first: curl -s URL -o /tmp/resp.json 2>&1; then inspect with head -5 /tmp/resp.json before parsing. Check HTTP status with curl -w '%{http_code}'.

rationale: Rules cover the five observed failure categories: (1) two egress rules for the specific blocked hosts openml and github API with actionable alternatives; (2) a late_give_up rule to detect credential/GPU blockers early; (3) a turn_budget rule targeting the 'never submitted' pattern of excessive reading; (4) a nonzero_exit rule for grep returning 1 on no match; (5) two python_error rules for BrokenPipeError in notebook dumps and JSON parse failures from piped curl; (6) a timeout rule for empty command cells.
